profile.org_note: Family-owned and founder-led: Pat Neal (Founder & Chairman, owner) sits above a president (Douglas Miller, added about August 2026), a CFO (Nancy Reynolds) and an Executive VP of Land & Strategy (Jason Frost). Homebuilding is split into a North Division (Manatee/Sarasota) and a South Region (Lee/Collier, Tim Oak), with three brands: Neal Communities, Neal Signature Homes (luxury) and SimplyDwell Homes (attainable). Land decisions run through Pat Neal and Jason Frost; finance through Nancy Reynolds and Pamela Curran. Family affiliates sit alongside: Neal Land & Neighborhoods (John Neal, master-planned land developer) and a second land development company run by Michael Neal.
profile.summary: Private, family-owned Southwest Florida builder (founded 1970, about 27,000 homes built) selling in Manatee, Sarasota, Lee and Collier counties under Neal Communities, Neal Signature Homes and SimplyDwell Homes; headquarters at 5800 Lakewood Ranch Blvd N. It is a conventional for-sale homebuilder that buys and develops its own land: the company says it purchases the land it develops, and the founder says he is holding cash to buy more land, so it behaves more like a land owner than a land-light builder. Revenue fell to about $586M in 2025 from about $800M in 2024 (Business Observer), and a new president appeared on the leadership page around August 2026.

people.name: John Neal
people.title: President, Neal Land & Neighborhoods
people.source_title: Business Observer: After nearly $39M land deal, Parrish residential project begins selling homes
people.note: AFFILIATE, not a Neal Communities officer. Pat Neal's son runs Neal Land & Neighborhoods, the family's separate master-planned community developer (flagship North River Ranch in Parrish, approved for 6,000 residences), which sells land to third-party builders (a 400-plus acre site to Pulte's Del Webb for $38.7M in February 2025) and partners with Neal Communities on some projects. A second son, Michael Neal, runs another land development company (Grand Park and work for other builders) per a 2024 Business Observer profile; its name and his title were not confirmed, so he has no row.
